content_text:
Hi Mr DM,
There was an issue with the podcast’s distribution service earlier today, and the company decided to limit all shows to only the most recent 100 episodes. The issue has been resolved and they are currently working on restoring all previous episodes. They should be back up sometime soon. Our apologies for the inconvenience.
